a.title: The AI is in the computer

b.lede: Goodfire just launched what it says is a cheaper way to keep AI agents in check: Instead of paying a second AI to read everything an agent does, its monitors peek inside the model while it works and only call in backup when something looks fishy.
b.title: Goodfire says its new ‘inside-out’ monitors catch rogue AI agents at a fraction of the cost
